2	-- Channel-aware cross-force chat routing with spectator prefix tagging.
3	--
4	-- The engine delivers every chat message to the sender's CURRENT force before
5	-- any mod runs — that native delivery IS team chat, and no mod can cancel or
6	-- edit it. This handler adds everything else:
7	--   global channel (default): relay to every other force + bridge emit.
8	--   team-only channel: nothing to add — unless the sender is force-swapped
9	--     spectating, where the native copy went to the spectator force instead
10	--     of their team; the team copy is relayed here, tagged [spectating]. The
11	--     native copy remains visible to co-spectators (engine-imposed; disclosed
12	--     to the sender on entering spectate and via a soft sound per message).
13	--
14	-- MTS disables the bridge's baseline chat capture (remote_api.register_with_
15	-- bridge), so Discord only ever receives what this file explicitly emits:
16	-- global-channel messages, shouts, spectator/server chatter. Team-only
17	-- messages never leave the game.
18	
19	local spectator    = require("scripts.spectator")
20	local chat_channel = require("scripts.chat_channel")
21	local helpers      = require("scripts.helpers")
22	local remote_api   = require("scripts.remote_api")
23	
24	local M = {}
25	
26	function M.register()
27	    script.on_event(defines.events.on_console_chat, function(event)
28	        local message = event.message
29	        if type(message) ~= "string" or message == "" then return end
30	
31	        -- Server-console (stdin) messages have no player. The engine already
32	        -- shows them to everyone; only the bridge copy is owed here.
33	        if not event.player_index then
34	            remote_api.emit_chat("Server", message, nil)
35	            return
36	        end
37	        local author = game.get_player(event.player_index)
38	        if not author then return end
39	
40	        local effective = spectator.get_effective_force(author)
41	        local is_team   = helpers.is_team_force(effective)
42	        -- "!" shouts one message globally from a team-only channel.
43	        local shout     = message:find("^!") ~= nil
44	        local go_global = shout or not is_team
45	            or not chat_channel.is_local_for(author)
46	
47	        if go_global then
48	            local prefix = spectator.get_chat_prefix(author)
49	            for _, player in pairs(game.connected_players) do
50	                if player.force ~= author.force then
51	                    player.print(prefix .. author.name .. ": " .. message,
52	                                 {color = author.color})
53	                end
54	            end
55	            remote_api.emit_chat(author.name, message,
56	                is_team and effective or nil)
57	            return
58	        end
59	
60	        -- Team-only. Anyone sharing the author's ACTUAL force already has the
61	        -- native line; every other member of the effective team is reached
62	        -- here. That covers both directions of force-swapped spectating:
63	        -- a spectating author's line reaches the team (tagged, since their
64	        -- native copy went to the spectator force instead), and a spectating
65	        -- TEAMMATE still receives team chat sent from home.
66	        local author_swapped = author.force.name ~= effective
67	        local tag = author_swapped and "[spectating] " or ""
68	        for _, player in pairs(game.connected_players) do
69	            if player.index ~= author.index
70	               and player.force ~= author.force
71	               and spectator.get_effective_force(player) == effective then
72	                player.print(tag .. author.name .. ": " .. message,
73	                             {color = author.color})
74	            end
75	        end
76	        -- Soft cue: the author's native copy was visible to co-spectators.
77	        if author_swapped then
78	            author.play_sound{path = chat_channel.SOUND_EXPOSURE}
79	        end
80	    end)
81	end
82	
83	return M
84

6	-- every player-index-keyed storage table, in team_leader, and in cross-player
7	-- GUIs (a member's Accept/Reject dialog). Removed indexes can be reused, so a
8	-- new player inheriting a stale index would inherit the old player's state.
9	--
10	-- on_pre_player_removed fires BEFORE the engine deletes the player, so
11	-- game.get_player(index) is still valid here — the handler can read player.force
12	-- and run team_slots.remove_from_team (leader promotion / solo-disband). The
13	-- post-deletion on_player_removed can't, so it isn't used.
14	
15	local team_slots  = require("scripts.team_slots")
16	local force_utils = require("scripts.force_utils")
17	local buddy_store = require("scripts.buddy_store")
18	local follow_cam  = require("gui.follow_cam")
19	local spectator   = require("scripts.spectator")
20	
21	local M = {}
22	
23	-- Every player-index-keyed storage table. Kept next to the removal sweep so the
24	-- two stay in step. Excludes tables cleaned by a dedicated path:
25	--   • buddy_requests   -> buddy_store.clear (below)
26	--   • follow_cam (nested) -> follow_cam.on_player_left (below)
27	--   • team_leader (force-keyed value) -> team_slots.remove_from_team (below)
28	local PLAYER_TABLES = {
29	    -- landing pen / spawn
30	    "spawned_players", "pen_slots", "pen_gui_location", "pending_pen_tp",
31	    "pending_spawn_pop", "player_surfaces", "pending_vanilla_tp",
32	    "pending_platform_tp", "left_teams", "player_clock_start",
33	    -- GUI window state / positions
34	    "gui_location", "stats_gui_state", "stats_gui_location", "stats_category_items",
35	    "awards_gui_state", "awards_gui_location", "admin_gui_location",
36	    "research_gui_location", "research_gui_expanded", "research_gui_diff_target",
37	    "return_button_location", "team_settings_location", "follow_cam_location",
38	    "lfm_hint_close_tick",
39	    -- session / misc
40	    "seen_players", "player_last_seen", "show_offline_players", "god_pre_remote",
41	    "pending_admin_check", "odb_suppress_claim", "color_fix_last", "zoom_apply",
42	    -- spectator (flat, player-index-keyed)
43	    "spectator_real_force", "spectating_target", "spectator_saved_craft_mod",
44	    "spectator_saved_location", "spectator_prev_controller", "spectator_last_zoom",
45	    "spectator_last_remote_view",
46	    -- chat (individual scope; the team-scoped channel is force-keyed)
47	    "chat_channel_player",
48	}
49	
50	local function cleanup_player_storage(idx)
51	    for _, tbl in ipairs(PLAYER_TABLES) do
52	        if storage[tbl] then storage[tbl][idx] = nil end
53	    end
54	end
55	
56	function M.register()
57	    script.on_event(defines.events.on_pre_player_removed, function(event)
58	        local idx    = event.player_index
59	        local player = game.get_player(idx)
60	
61	        if player and player.valid then
62	            -- Restore a spectating member to their real force first, so
63	            -- remove_from_team acts on the actual team, not "spectator".
64	            if spectator.is_spectating(player) then spectator.exit(player) end
65	            -- Leader promotion / solo-disband / left_teams bookkeeping / slot
66	            -- release all live in remove_from_team — run it while the player and
67	            -- the force roster are still intact.
68	            if force_utils.is_team_force(player.force.name) then
69	                team_slots.remove_from_team(player)
70	            end
71	            -- Drop this player's follow-cam state (nested by index).
72	            follow_cam.on_player_left(player)
73	        end
74	
75	        -- Drop any join request this player had pending (as requester) and its
76	        -- Accept/Reject frames on members' screens. Requests TO this player's
77	        -- former team are handled by wipe_slot_state if they were the last
78	        -- member (via remove_from_team above).
79	        buddy_store.clear(idx)
80	
81	        cleanup_player_storage(idx)
82	    end)
83	end
84	
85	return M

17	        if not (player and player.connected) then return end
18	
19	        helpers.diag("on_player_changed_surface (before handlers)", player)
20	        if spectator.is_spectating(player)
21	           and player.controller_type ~= defines.controllers.remote then
22	            spectator.exit(player)
23	        end
24	        spectator.on_player_changed_surface(player)
25	        force_utils.bounce_if_foreign(player)
26	        -- Refresh Teams GUI only when already open: surface changes shouldn't
27	        -- force the panel back onto players who closed it for screen space.
28	        if player.gui.screen.sb_platforms_frame then
29	            teams_gui.build_gui(player)
30	        end
31	        return_button.update(player)
32	
33	        -- Snapshot whether this surface change is the player's initial spawn,
34	        -- so first-landing announcements can suppress the fanfare for the
35	        -- starting planet while still marking it as seen.
36	        local was_spawning = (storage.pending_spawn_pop or {})[player.index] ~= nil
37	        global_milestones.check_planet_landing(player, was_spawning)
38	
39	        -- Fire spawn/join popups once the player has landed on their team
40	        -- surface (pending flag set in player_force.lua's on_player_changed_force).
41	        local pending = (storage.pending_spawn_pop or {})[player.index]
42	        if pending and force_utils.is_team_force(player.force.name)
43	           and player.surface.name ~= "landing-pen" then
44	            storage.pending_spawn_pop[player.index] = nil
45	            pop_text.spawn_confirm(player, player.position,
46	                "Welcome " .. helpers.colored_name(player.name, player.chat_color) .. "!")
47	            local force = player.force
48	            for _, mate in pairs(force.players) do
49	                if mate.connected and mate.index ~= player.index
50	                   and mate.surface.index == player.surface.index then
51	                    pop_text.team_join(mate, mate.position,
52	                        helpers.colored_name(player.name, player.chat_color) .. " joined!")
53	                end
54	            end
55	        end
56	
57	        helpers.diag("on_player_changed_surface (after handlers)", player)
58	    end)
59	
60	    script.on_event(defines.events.on_player_controller_changed, function(event)
61	        local player = game.get_player(event.player_index)
62	        if not (player and player.connected) then return end
63	
64	        helpers.diag("on_player_controller_changed (before handlers, old_ctrl="
65	            .. tostring(event.old_type) .. ")", player)
66	
67	        -- Anchor god-mode position across remote-view round-trips so pressing
68	        -- Esc in Platformer mode doesn't drop the god cursor onto the wrong surface.
69	        storage.god_pre_remote = storage.god_pre_remote or {}
70	        if event.old_type == defines.controllers.god
71	           and player.controller_type == defines.controllers.remote
72	           and player.physical_surface and player.physical_surface.valid then
73	            storage.god_pre_remote[player.index] = {
74	                surface_name = player.physical_surface.name,
75	                position     = { x = player.physical_position.x, y = player.physical_position.y },
76	            }
77	        elseif event.old_type == defines.controllers.remote
78	           and player.controller_type == defines.controllers.god then
79	            local saved = storage.god_pre_remote[player.index]
80	            storage.god_pre_remote[player.index] = nil
81	            if saved and player.physical_surface
82	               and player.physical_surface.name ~= saved.surface_name then
83	                local s = game.surfaces[saved.surface_name]
84	                if s and s.valid then
85	                    helpers.diag("god_pre_remote: restoring god to " .. saved.surface_name, player)
86	                    player.teleport(saved.position, s)
87	                end
88	            end
89	        end
90	
91	        spectator.on_controller_changed(player, event.old_type)
92	        force_utils.bounce_if_foreign(player)
93	        return_button.update(player)
94	        helpers.diag("on_player_controller_changed (after handlers)", player)
95	    end)
96	end

4	--
5	-- Generic milestone tracking engine. Polls production counters and
6	-- announces first/fastest records when teams cross configured thresholds.
7	--
8	-- Polled every 300 ticks (5 seconds) via on_nth_tick in control.lua.
9	-- Uses the shared records module for first/fastest logic.
10	
11	local records     = require("scripts.records")
12	local helpers     = require("scripts.helpers")
13	local force_utils = require("scripts.force_utils")
14	local config      = require("milestones.config")
15	local pop_text    = require("scripts.pop_text")
16	local team_modifiers = require("scripts.team_modifiers")

19	--- Strip Factorio rich-text tags (e.g. "[item=foo]" -> "foo") so milestone text
20	--- reads cleanly in Discord, which can't render them.
21	local function plain(s)
22	    return (s:gsub("%[%a+=([%w%-_./]+)%]", "%1"))
23	end
24	
25	local engine = {}
26	
27	-- Special threshold marker for "first to produce" (count >= 1).
28	-- Stored under this key in milestone_records and milestone_reached.
29	local FIRST_THRESHOLD = 0
30	
31	-- Reset on every load (module-local). engine.tick re-discovers once per session if this is
32	-- still false, so trackers added to config since the save's last on_init / on_configuration_-
33	-- changed are picked up on a plain reload (storage.milestone_items persists, so a new tracker
34	-- would otherwise stay invisible until a config change).
35	local discovered_this_session = false
36	
37	-- ─── Storage Initialization ───────────────────────────────────────────
38	
39	function engine.init_storage()
40	    storage.milestone_records  = storage.milestone_records  or {}
41	    storage.milestone_reached  = storage.milestone_reached  or {}
42	    storage.milestone_items    = storage.milestone_items    or {}
43	    storage.milestone_external = storage.milestone_external or {}
44	end
45	
46	--- Build a short two-line popup string for the milestone overlay.
47	---   is_first + first-threshold  → "First!\n[item=X]"
48	---   is_first + count-threshold  → "First!\n100x [item=X]"
49	---   fastest  + any threshold    → "New record!\n[same]"
50	local function build_popup(label, item_name, threshold)
51	    local item_tag = helpers.item_rich_name(item_name)
52	    if threshold == FIRST_THRESHOLD then
53	        return label .. "\n" .. item_tag
54	    end
55	    return label .. "\n" .. threshold .. "x " .. item_tag
56	end
57	
58	--- Run each tracker's discover_items function to build the item set.
59	--- Called on_init and on_configuration_changed to handle mod changes.
60	function engine.discover_items()
61	    engine.init_storage()
62	    storage.milestone_items = {}
63	    for _, tracker in ipairs(config.trackers) do
64	        local items = tracker.discover_items() or {}
65	        storage.milestone_items[tracker.category] = items
66	    end
67	    discovered_this_session = true
68	end
69	
70	-- ─── Announcement Helpers ─────────────────────────────────────────────
71	
72	--- Build the description of what was achieved.
73	---   first threshold + science → "produce their first [item=automation-science-pack]"
74	---   100 threshold + landfill  → "produce 100 [item=landfill]"
75	local function build_achievement_desc(tracker, item_name, threshold)
76	    if threshold == FIRST_THRESHOLD then
77	        return "produce their first " .. helpers.item_rich_name(item_name)
78	    end
79	    return string.format("produce %d %s", threshold, helpers.item_rich_name(item_name))
80	end
81	
82	--- Announce a "first to X" milestone. The prefix carries a non-competitive
83	--- tag while that mode is on — records earned under uneven per-team settings
84	--- stay visible but wear an asterisk.
85	local function announce_first(team_tag, achievement)
86	    helpers.broadcast(string.format(
87	        "%s %s was the first to %s!",
88	        team_modifiers.records_tag(), team_tag, achievement
89	    ))
90	end
91	
92	--- Announce a new speed record for an existing milestone.
93	local function announce_speed_record(team_tag, achievement, new_elapsed, prev_team_tag, prev_elapsed)
94	    helpers.broadcast(string.format(
95	        "%s %s is fastest to %s in %s (previous record: %s in %s)",
96	        team_modifiers.records_tag(), team_tag, achievement,
97	        helpers.format_elapsed(new_elapsed),
98	        prev_team_tag,
99	        helpers.format_elapsed(prev_elapsed)
100	    ))
101	end
102	
103	-- ─── Milestone Check Logic ────────────────────────────────────────────
104	
105	--- Check a single (tracker, item, force, threshold) combination.
106	--- If the force has crossed the threshold and not yet recorded it:
107	---   - Mark as reached (prevents re-announcing)
108	---   - Update records (first/fastest)
109	---   - Announce as appropriate
110	--- Returns true if a new milestone was recorded, false if already reached.
111	local function check_milestone(tracker, item_name, force, threshold)
112	    local key = tracker.category .. ":" .. item_name
113	
114	    -- Track per-team "reached" state so we only announce each crossing once
115	    storage.milestone_reached[force.name] = storage.milestone_reached[force.name] or {}
116	    storage.milestone_reached[force.name][key] = storage.milestone_reached[force.name][key] or {}
117	    if storage.milestone_reached[force.name][key][threshold] then return false end
118	
119	    storage.milestone_reached[force.name][key][threshold] = true
120	
121	    -- Record key includes threshold so "first-to-produce" and "first-to-100" are separate
122	    local record_key = key .. "@" .. threshold
123	    local result = records.update(storage.milestone_records, record_key, force.name, game.tick)
124	
125	    local team_tag    = helpers.team_tag(force.name)
126	    local achievement = build_achievement_desc(tracker, item_name, threshold)
127	    local team_name   = (storage.team_names or {})[force.name] or force.name
128	
129	    if result.is_first then
130	        announce_first(team_tag, achievement)
131	        pop_text.milestone(force, build_popup("First!", item_name, threshold))
132	        remote_api.emit_to_bridge("mts.milestone_first", {
133	            team        = team_name,
134	            achievement = plain(achievement),
135	            text        = string.format("%s was the first to %s", team_name, plain(achievement)),
136	        })
137	    elseif result.is_fastest then
138	        local prev = result.previous_fastest
139	        local new_entry = storage.milestone_records[record_key].fastest
140	        announce_speed_record(
141	            team_tag, achievement,
142	            new_entry.elapsed,
143	            helpers.team_tag(prev.team),
144	            prev.elapsed
145	        )
146	        pop_text.milestone(force, build_popup("New record!", item_name, threshold))
147	        local prev_team = (storage.team_names or {})[prev.team] or prev.team
148	        remote_api.emit_to_bridge("mts.milestone_record", {
149	            team             = team_name,
150	            achievement      = plain(achievement),
151	            elapsed          = new_entry.elapsed,
152	            previous_team    = prev_team,
153	            previous_elapsed = prev.elapsed,
154	            text             = string.format(
155	                "%s is now fastest to %s in %s (previous: %s in %s)",
156	                team_name, plain(achievement),
157	                helpers.format_elapsed(new_entry.elapsed),
158	                prev_team, helpers.format_elapsed(prev.elapsed)
159	            ),
160	        })
161	    end
162	    return true
163	end
164	
165	--- Check all thresholds for a single (tracker, item, force).
166	--- Returns true if any milestone was newly recorded.
167	local function check_all_thresholds(tracker, item_name, force)
168	    local count = tracker.get_count(force, item_name)
169	    if count < 1 then return false end
170	
171	    local changed = false
172	
173	    -- "First to produce" milestone (threshold 0 marker)
174	    if tracker.announce_first then
175	        if check_milestone(tracker, item_name, force, FIRST_THRESHOLD) then
176	            changed = true
177	        end
178	    end
179	
180	    -- Numeric thresholds
181	    for _, threshold in ipairs(tracker.thresholds) do
182	        if count >= threshold then
183	            if check_milestone(tracker, item_name, force, threshold) then
184	                changed = true
185	            end
186	        end
187	    end
188	
189	    return changed
190	end

192	-- ─── Tick Handler ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
193	
194	--- Called every 300 ticks (5 seconds) from control.lua's on_nth_tick.
195	--- Iterates all trackers × items × occupied teams and checks thresholds.
196	--- Returns true if any new milestone was recorded this tick (so the caller
197	--- can refresh dependent GUIs without re-polling storage).
198	function engine.tick()
199	    engine.init_storage()
200	    -- Self-heal discovery after a plain reload (on_init / on_configuration_changed didn't run),
201	    -- so trackers added to config.lua since this save's last config change start tracking.
202	    if not discovered_this_session then
203	        engine.discover_items()
204	    end
205	
206	    local changed = false
207	    for _, tracker in ipairs(config.trackers) do
208	        local items = storage.milestone_items[tracker.category] or {}
209	        for item_name in pairs(items) do
210	            for _, force in pairs(game.forces) do
211	                if force_utils.is_team_force(force.name) and #force.players > 0 then
212	                    if check_all_thresholds(tracker, item_name, force) then
213	                        changed = true
214	                    end
215	                end
216	            end
217	        end
218	    end
219	    return changed
220	end

222	-- ─── External (consumer-reported) milestones ──────────────────────────
223	-- A mod reports a per-team counter (e.g. Expanse cells unlocked) via
224	-- remote.call("mts-v1","report_milestone",...); we announce first/fastest using the same
225	-- records + broadcast + Discord machinery as the built-in trackers. The registry is
226	-- persisted; reporting is event-driven (no polling). remote_api requires this module, not
227	-- the reverse, so the interface entries are injected at the bottom.
228	
229	local function build_external_achievement(spec, threshold, first_only)
230	    local verb = spec.verb or "reach"
231	    if first_only then
232	        return verb .. " their first " .. spec.noun
233	    end
234	    return string.format("%s %d %s", verb, threshold, spec.noun .. "s")
235	end
236	
237	-- first_only: announce first-to-reach only (no speed record). Used for the smallest
238	-- threshold, where a "fastest" race isn't wanted (e.g. the very first unlock).
239	local function check_external(spec, force, threshold, first_only)
240	    local key = "ext:" .. spec.category
241	    storage.milestone_reached[force.name] = storage.milestone_reached[force.name] or {}
242	    storage.milestone_reached[force.name][key] = storage.milestone_reached[force.name][key] or {}
243	    if storage.milestone_reached[force.name][key][threshold] then return end
244	    storage.milestone_reached[force.name][key][threshold] = true
245	
246	    local record_key   = key .. "@" .. threshold
247	    local result       = records.update(storage.milestone_records, record_key, force.name, game.tick)
248	    local team_tag     = helpers.team_tag(force.name)
249	    local team_name    = (storage.team_names or {})[force.name] or force.name
250	    local achievement  = build_external_achievement(spec, threshold, first_only)
251	    local popup_detail = first_only and spec.noun or (threshold .. " " .. spec.noun .. "s")
252	
253	    if result.is_first then
254	        announce_first(team_tag, achievement)
255	        pop_text.milestone(force, "First!\n" .. popup_detail)
256	        remote_api.emit_to_bridge("mts.milestone_first", {
257	            team        = team_name,
258	            achievement = achievement,
259	            text        = string.format("%s was the first to %s", team_name, achievement),
260	        })
261	    elseif not first_only and result.is_fastest then
262	        local prev      = result.previous_fastest
263	        local new_entry = storage.milestone_records[record_key].fastest
264	        announce_speed_record(team_tag, achievement, new_entry.elapsed,
265	            helpers.team_tag(prev.team), prev.elapsed)
266	        pop_text.milestone(force, "New record!\n" .. popup_detail)
267	        local prev_team = (storage.team_names or {})[prev.team] or prev.team
268	        remote_api.emit_to_bridge("mts.milestone_record", {
269	            team             = team_name,
270	            achievement      = achievement,
271	            elapsed          = new_entry.elapsed,
272	            previous_team    = prev_team,
273	            previous_elapsed = prev.elapsed,
274	            text             = string.format(
275	                "%s is now fastest to %s in %s (previous: %s in %s)",
276	                team_name, achievement, helpers.format_elapsed(new_entry.elapsed),
277	                prev_team, helpers.format_elapsed(prev.elapsed)),
278	        })
279	    end
280	end
281	
282	--- Register a consumer milestone. spec = { category, verb, noun, first_threshold, thresholds }.
283	--- first_threshold (optional) gets a first-to-reach announcement only; each entry in
284	--- thresholds gets both first AND fastest.
285	function engine.register_external(spec)
286	    if type(spec) ~= "table" or type(spec.category) ~= "string" then return end
287	    engine.init_storage()
288	    storage.milestone_external[spec.category] = {
289	        category        = spec.category,
290	        verb            = spec.verb or "reach",
291	        noun            = spec.noun or spec.category,
292	        first_threshold = type(spec.first_threshold) == "number" and spec.first_threshold or nil,
293	        thresholds      = spec.thresholds or {},
294	    }
295	end
296	
297	--- Report a team's current value for a registered consumer milestone.
298	function engine.report_external(force_name, category, count)
299	    if type(count) ~= "number" then return end
300	    engine.init_storage()
301	    local spec = storage.milestone_external[category]
302	    if not spec then return end
303	    -- Guard force_name before indexing game.forces with it: a non-string key
304	    -- (LuaForce/number/table) errors otherwise (AT-1). is_team_force is now
305	    -- type-safe, so this rejects bad input without crashing.
306	    if not force_utils.is_team_force(force_name) then return end
307	    local force = game.forces[force_name]
308	    if not (force and force.valid) then return end
309	
310	    if spec.first_threshold and count >= spec.first_threshold then
311	        check_external(spec, force, spec.first_threshold, true)
312	    end
313	    for _, threshold in ipairs(spec.thresholds) do
314	        if count >= threshold then
315	            check_external(spec, force, threshold, false)
316	        end
317	    end
318	end
319	
320	remote_api.register_milestone_impl = engine.register_external
321	remote_api.report_milestone_impl   = engine.report_external
322	
323	return engine
